_help: Edit this file to add/remove project categories and projects. The homepage 'All projects' area is static, but projects/index.html and the per-category pages (projects/*.html) render from this file. 'accent' is one of purple | teal | pink. 'icon' is an emoji shown in the tile. Per project: name, tagline, href (page/github link, or leave null for a draft), status ('live' | 'draft').
